rights_basis: Owner approved on 2026-11-14 for JP/US/KR after AI research and independent review. 森鴎外 died in 1922; 高瀬舟 first appeared in 中央公論 (January 1916). Japan: life+50 term ended in 1972, before the 2018 extension, and is not revived. U.S.: a 1916 publication is beyond the 95-year maximum. South Korea: retroactive protection for foreign works covers only authors who died in 1957 or later. Scope is the exact Aozora text file only.
